added: packages/causal (@sos-2/causal): CausalHypothesis artifacts (frozen core kind) as spine envelopes + content carrying the full hypothesis contract — intervention description, mechanism, predicted outcomes, retained ASSUMPTIONS (>= 1), context (>= 1 fact), ALTERNATIVE EXPLANATIONS (each retained verbatim, never collapsed — diversity discipline), refutation conditions (>= 1 — falsifiability is mandatory), the minimal causal graph, strictly class-separated evidence references, calibrated-or-qualitative uncertainty, producer and optional correlation origin; the CLAIM GATE (spec/architecture.md §18) validates the asserted claim_strength at construction, at every revision and at promotion: a CAUSAL claim requires >= 1 INTERVENTIONAL evidence reference with availability SUCCESS, delegated to @sos-2/evidence's supportsStrongCausalClaim (the merged W3 authority — never re-implemented)

packages/causal evidence-refs: ObservationalEvidenceRef and InterventionalEvidenceRef as DISTINCT types (evidence_class literal discriminant; distinct validators; builders observationalEvidenceRef/interventionalEvidenceRef THROW on class mismatch — an observational record can never be laundered into an interventional reference); assertNoDuplicateEvidenceReferences rejects citing the same evidence record twice (within one class array or across both); each reference is a provenance snapshot (evidence id, subject, truth state, exact source/subject revisions, window) realizing 'which evidence records, which revisions'

packages/causal graph: the minimal causal graph — CausalFactor + typed edges CONTRIBUTES_TO (cause -> effect) and CONFOUNDS (confounder on a confounded cause -> effect relation); validation rejects duplicate factor ids, unknown endpoints, self-edges, duplicate edges and a confounder participating in its own relation; cycles are PERMITTED and documented (full causal inference is explicitly out of scope); deterministic queries factorsContributingTo/confoundersOf

packages/causal correlation: CorrelationRecord artifacts (documented, explicitly-registered spine extension kind 'CorrelationRecord' via the sanctioned add-only registerArtifactKind API — the W3 ProvenanceRecord precedent) — an observed association with >= 2 variables, direction, context, class-separated evidence references (>= 1), uncertainty and producer; the type is structurally INCAPABLE of expressing causation (no claim strength, no mechanism, no graph); hypothesisFromCorrelation is the ONLY promotion path: explicit, evidence-gated (throws without interventional SUCCESS evidence — a correlation is never silently promoted) and traced (correlation_origin field + DERIVED_FROM link)

packages/causal store: CausalKnowledgeStore — envelope lifecycle for hypotheses and correlations (contiguous version+1 supersedes chains, ACTIVE-only revision, kind integrity across supersedes), SUPPORTS links minted from every distinct evidence reference (evidence -> artifact traceability), DERIVED_FROM links for revisions and promotions, history()/activeHypotheses()/evidenceSupporting() queries; revisions re-run the claim gate and preserve correlation_origin

packages/memory (@sos-2/memory): ArchitectureMemory artifacts (frozen core kind) as spine envelopes + versioned content holding the seven memory entry kinds from spec/architecture.md §5 — PREDICTION, OBSERVATION, OUTCOME, FAILURE, LIABILITY, ROLLBACK, LEARNED_RULE — with per-kind validation (observations/outcomes/failures/rollbacks and learned rules REQUIRE >= 1 evidence reference; predictions reference optional CausalHypothesis ids; outcomes carry a REALIZED/NOT_REALIZED/UNKNOWN verdict and prediction refs)

packages/memory liability: technical liabilities as first-class records — severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), owner-kind (HUMAN/TEAM/SERVICE/GOVERNANCE) and a resolution with a validated state machine (OPEN -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> MITIGATED -> RESOLVED, with ACCEPTED as the risk-acceptance terminal; MITIGATED/RESOLVED require resolution evidence; RESOLVED requires a timestamp); failure memory retains failure contexts verbatim (a failure entry must carry a non-null context and is immutable across revisions)

packages/memory update discipline: every memory update carries provenance (producer + evidence_refs, both validated; envelope provenance non-empty per spine discipline); revisions are versioned supersedes chains with the append-only evolution rule enforced by assertValidMemoryEvolution — no entry may EVER be dropped, failure entries are immutable, liability entries may change ONLY in resolution (with valid state transitions), all other entries are immutable and only new entries may be appended; the ArchitectureMemoryStore keeps complete, contiguous, queryable history (history(), entriesOf(), failuresOf(), liabilitiesOf(), learnedRulesOf() — all deterministic, sorted by entry id)

packages/memory learned rules: LEARNED_RULE entries carry applicability context (non-empty plain JSON object — a silent universal rule is rejected) + supporting evidence references (>= 1 — rules without evidence are rejected) + uncertainty (qualitative class unless calibration exists)

packages/causal/ARCHITECTURE-DELTA.json + packages/memory/ARCHITECTURE-DELTA.json: these Architecture Delta records — DECLARED HERE because spec/** is outside W5's owned paths; the Architect may reconcile them into spec/contracts/deltas/ at merge time
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace authority: both packages import minters, envelopes, trace links, canonical serialization and truth states from @sos-2/semantic-spine; no second identity system, no duplicated envelope logic, no invented core identifiers (CausalHypothesis and ArchitectureMemory are frozen core kinds used as-is)

the locked invariant 'intervention evidence outranks observational correlation for strong causal claims' (spec/architecture.md §18, spec/architecture-lock.md 'causal evidence semantics') is CONSUMED from @sos-2/evidence (supportsStrongCausalClaim) and enforced at construction, revision and promotion; observational evidence — however many records — never elevates a claim past correlation

the OBSERVATIONAL/INTERVENTIONAL evidence classes remain semantically distinct and never conflated: causal knowledge references them through two distinct types with a class-literal discriminant; class mismatch and double citation are rejected loudly

numeric confidence is valid only where calibration exists (calibration_ref MUST be a well-formed spine artifact id — the @sos-2/evidence Confidence contract, consumed unchanged); otherwise a qualitative uncertainty class is used; LLM producers can never carry calibrated confidence (an LLM self-reported confidence value is never calibrated truth, spec/meta-model.md)

LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization (spec/architecture.md §18): hypotheses, correlation records and memory updates carry the W3 Producer and the derived llm_output mark — LLM involvement can never be hidden or claimed falsely
the 17 frozen trace link types are USED, not extended: SUPPORTS (evidence -> hypothesis/correlation/memory) and DERIVED_FROM (revision lineage, correlation -> hypothesis promotion)

evidence is referenced by exact spine ids (deterministic, content-addressed) with revision snapshots preserved (source_revision, subject_revision, window) — every promoted change is reproducible from exact revisions and evidence (R30)

memory never forgets: no memory entry is ever dropped across revisions; failure contexts are retained verbatim; technical liabilities can only change resolution state (never statement, severity or owner-kind, never deleted); unknown, failed, unavailable and unsupported remain distinct (truth states are imported, never redefined)
diversity is intentional (spec §11): alternative explanations are retained verbatim and never collapsed into a single winner; correlations are never silently promoted

no frozen contract in spec/contracts/ was modified; spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths are untouched — all W5 changes are additive under the two owned packages packages/causal and packages/memory
boundary_changes: new workspace packages @sos-2/causal and @sos-2/memory; @sos-2/causal depends at runtime on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/evidence and @sos-2/provenance; @sos-2/memory depends at runtime on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/evidence and @sos-2/provenance (both consume the merged W0.5/W1/W3 authorities and duplicate nothing)
one documented spine extension kind registered through the sanctioned add-only API: 'CorrelationRecord' (W5-owned; follows the W3 'ProvenanceRecord' precedent — no frozen core kind is touched)
